targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(created_at)
            AND status IN (
                'PENDING',
                'QUEUED',
                'READY'
            )
    )::bigint
        AS "OUTBOX_PENDING",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(created_at)
            AND status IN (
                'FAILED',
                'ERROR'
            )
    )::bigint
        AS "OUTBOX_FAILED",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(created_at)
            AND status IN (
                'PUBLISHED',
                'COMPLETED',
                'SUCCESS'
            )
    )::bigint
        AS "OUTBOX_PUBLISHED",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(created_at)
            AND retry_count > 0
    )::bigint
        AS "OUTBOX_RETRIED"

FROM common_outboxevent

panels.title: 비동기 이벤트 처리 추이

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(
        created_at,
        '1h'
    ),

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN (
            'PUBLISHED',
            'COMPLETED',
            'SUCCESS'
        )
    )::double precision AS "발행 완료",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN (
            'PENDING',
            'QUEUED',
            'READY'
        )
    )::double precision AS "대기",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN (
            'FAILED',
            'ERROR'
        )
    )::double precision AS "실패"

FROM common_outboxevent
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 최근 비동기 이벤트

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    created_at AS "발생 시각",
    event_type AS "이벤트",
    aggregate_type AS "대상",
    status AS "상태",
    retry_count AS "재시도",
    published_at AS "발행 시각"
FROM common_outboxevent
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.description: 최근 Outbox 이벤트의 종류 · 상태 · 재시도 여부를 확인하여 실제 문제 이벤트를 추적합니다.

    created_at
        AS "생성 시각",

    event_type
        AS "이벤트",

    aggregate_type
        AS "대상 유형",

    aggregate_id
        AS "대상 ID",

    status
        AS "상태",

    retry_count
        AS "재시도",

    published_at
        AS "발행 시각",

    COALESCE(
        payload ->> 'request_id',
        '-'
    )
        AS request_id

WHERE
    $__timeFilter(created_at)

    AND status IN (
        'PENDING',
        'QUEUED',
        'READY'
    )

ORDER BY created_at DESC
